inputs.question: How do I reset my password?

outputs.answer: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page to reset your password by email.

inputs.question: Can I change the email on my account?

outputs.answer: Change your email under Settings, Profile; we send a confirmation link to the new address.
You are charged on the first day of each billing cycle.

inputs.question: How do I get a refund?

outputs.answer: Request a refund within 30 days from Orders, Request refund.
We ship to 40 countries; shipping options appear at checkout.

inputs.question: How long does standard shipping take?

outputs.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days.

inputs.question: Can I return a sale item?

outputs.answer: Sale items can be returned within 14 days in original condition.
Track your order from Orders, Track shipment, using the tracking number.
